newsitem.title: CANADA: TD Bank cuts prime to 4.75 pct from 5.00.
newsitem.headline: TD Bank cuts prime to 4.75 pct from 5.00.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Friday it cut its prime lending rate to 4.75 percent from 5.00 percent, effective on Tuesday.
The move followed a Bank of Canada rate cut of 25 basis points to 3.25 percent.
It matched an identical move by the Bank of Nova Scotia.
Canada's major banks last changed their prime lending rates on October 29, when they lowered them to 5.00 percent from 5.25 percent.
The prime rate is the rate charged by banks on loans to their best customers.
